user.title: Add a soil probe
user.description: Pick the probe's raw AD sensor if it has one, otherwise its moisture % sensor. Only raw AD can be calibrated dry and wet.

data_description.name: The probe's device name, for example its location.
data_description.model: Sets the default calibration. Pick Generic if your probe isn't listed.
data_description.raw_ad_entity: The probe's raw reading. Use this when the probe has one.
data_description.moisture_entity: Only for a probe without a raw AD sensor. Its percentage can be corrected on the device page.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.description: Generic probes have no default calibration. Enter the probe's raw AD reading at 0 % and at 100 % moisture. You can change both later on the device page.

error.one_source: Pick either a raw AD sensor or a moisture % sensor, not both.
error.span_too_small: Must be at least 10 above the 0 % reading.
